description: Change the share link settings on a Lite server (by id or exact name): the password used to start the server through the link, whether a password is required at all, whether the link is locked, and the Discord invite shown on the share page. Only the fields you pass are changed. Setting `password` replaces it, so the previous one stops working.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set this only after showing the user exactly what will be changed, restating the new share settings and getting their approval.

discord_url.description: Discord invite URL shown on the share page. Pass an empty string to clear it.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

locked.description: Whether the share link is locked, preventing it from being used to start the server.

password.description: New share password. Replaces the existing one.

password_enabled.description: Whether starting the server through the share link requires the password.

name: set_jit_share
title: Change Share Link Settings
